question: Which branch of the government is responsible for implementing laws and policies?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__Executive__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The executive **is the government branch responsible for implementing laws and policies. 
 
• This branch of government has the sole authority and responsibility for administration.
 
• This branch is headed by the president.</strong&g
